newMessage.title: New message
newMessage.empty: Nobody to write to yet. People you connect with appear here.

comingSoon.title: Messages are coming later
comingSoon.body: You can't write to someone here yet. Until then, a Cheer from Circle is the quickest way to let a friend know you're with them.

preview.wantsToJoin: Wants to join your Support Circle
preview.allyEncourager: Wants you to cheer their Journey as an Encourager. You'll see overall progress, not the step names.
preview.allyCompanion: Wants you to follow their Journey as a Companion. You'll see the step names and their status.

chats.title: No conversations yet
chats.body: When you write to someone, or they write to you, it will be here.

requests.title: No requests
requests.body: A message from someone you have not spoken to yet waits here first.

groups.title: Groups are on the way
groups.body: A place for a few people to hold something together. It is not built yet, and we would rather show you where it will live than pretend it is here.

request.preview: Would like to write to you
request.privateToRead: Reading this is private — they are not told. Accepting lets them write to you, and does not make you friends.

conversation.encrypted: Messages here are encrypted. Only the two of you can read them.
conversation.unavailable: This message cannot be opened on this device.
